title: Skin Cloth
description:
You don't have to open Menu.
You can take off your outerwear with just a single key press.
body: Tired of fiddling with skin customization menus? Say goodbye to the hassle! This mod lets you instantly shed your outerwear with a single key press! But wait, there's more! Dive into the key settings to assign unique hotkeys for each clothing part, giving you ultimate control. Get ready to revolutionize your quick-change game and enjoy a seamless dressing experience!
